```{r}
library(tidyverse)


isopods_long <- isopods %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("Orange juveniles", "Black juveniles"),
    names_to = "Morph",
    values_to = "Juveniles"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Date = as.Date(Date, format = "%b %d, %Y")
  )

ggplot(isopods_long,
       aes(x = Date, y = Juveniles, color = Morph)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Orange juveniles" = "darkorange",
      "Black juveniles" = "black"
    )
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Orange vs. Black Isopod Juvenile Population",
    subtitle = "Changes in juvenile counts over time",
    x = "Date",
    y = "Number of Juveniles",
    color = "Juvenile Color",
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
